summary: There's a part of you that knows a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you draw people in and know what you want and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people. At the edge, you smooth things over, or lose yourself in wanting it.
body: There's a part of you that knows a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you draw people in and know what you want and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people. At the edge, you smooth things over, or lose yourself in wanting it. Magnetic and persuasive; the intensity has to be moderated. Love may bring up questions of power, trust, and self-protection. Affection can feel intense because it touches places where vulnerability does not feel simple.
gift: At your best: you draw people in and know what you want, and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people.
shadow: The trap: you smooth things over, or lose yourself in wanting it — or you grip too hard, test people, or burn it down before it can leave you.
integration: Let love and values and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Magnetic and persuasive; the intensity has to be moderated.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you draw people in and you go deep work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
